value.name: writes house rules
value.description: Asha drafts a set of strict rules governing how she must interact with the family.
evidence: Do not stay past business hours unless a specific document or conversation requires it. Do not address Daniel by his first name in the presence of his sister. Do not address Lucia by her first name in the presence of her brother. Do not allow Rosa to serve you anything. Do not, under any circumstances, take a phone call from any of the three at a personal number, in the evening, alone in the apartment.

value.name: reflects on rulemaking
value.description: Asha feels satisfied with the rules but also recognizes they exist because the situation is difficult to manage.
evidence: She read the rules over once. She felt the small administrative satisfaction of having made them. She also felt, beneath the satisfaction, the precise and familiar pressure of the fact that rules existed because they were difficult to keep

value.name: notes unusual case duration
value.description: Asha realizes she has not written rules of engagement for any other case in fifteen years.
evidence: she had not, in fifteen years, written rules of engagement for any other case.

value.name: goes home
value.description: After closing the document, Asha leaves and goes home.
evidence: She closed the document. She went home.

value.name: arrives at house in morning
value.description: The next morning, Asha arrives at the house at nine.
evidence: In the morning she was at the house at nine.

value.name: Lucia opens the door
value.description: Lucia answers the door and appears casually dressed but clean, suggesting a strained morning routine.
evidence: Lucia answered the door. She had washed her hair. She was wearing a dark sweater that Asha suspected had belonged to her mother and a pair of jeans that did not match the sweater in any season

value.name: Lucia greets Asha
value.description: Lucia and Asha exchange a brief morning greeting.

value.name: Lucia says Daniel is already there
value.description: Lucia tells Asha that Daniel has already arrived.

value.name: Daniel arrives early with croissants
value.description: Lucia explains that Daniel came at eight and brought croissants as a likely apology.
evidence: "He came at eight. He brought croissants."
"From the place on Twentieth. I think it's his way of apologizing without using words."

value.name: Rosa puts croissants in kitchen
value.description: Rosa takes the croissants into the kitchen and pretends not to notice them.
